にうむ先生、初めまして。
お医者さんVtuberのルティスと申します。
友達の綾音ちゃんに先生をすすめ、素晴らしいイラストを拝見しました！
とてもかっこよくて感動しました！

使用用途は主に配信・動画・SNSなどです。
使う際ににうむ先生をクレジットします！

受けていただけたら幸いです。
よろしくお願いします！

I came to know about Niumu-sensei through my friend Rutis-chan's recommendation, and I fell in love with her wonderful illustrations, so I decided to request her! If you don't mind, could you draw my Vtuber character? I'm a little screwed up and quiet girl who lives on the planet 612 with a potato dog. I'd like to leave the composition, pose, etc. to you.  The use is mainly for distribution, video, SNS, etc. I do not do commercial use. I'll credit you when I use it! I'd be happy if you accept. Thank you very much!
